## SECTION 5: PUBLISHED URDU POETRY WORKS

Suleman Zaheer is a published Urdu poet composing classical Ghazals and modern Nazms.
Official Poetry Catalog URL: https://suleman-zaheer.vercel.app/poetry

1. **تیرے بغیر (Tere Baghair)** — 2024 — Urdu Ghazal (Theme: Love, Absence & Longing)
2. **خاموشی (Khamoshi)** — 2024 — Urdu Nazm (Theme: Silence, Introspection & Solitude)
3. **وقت کا سفر (Waqt Ka Safar)** — 2024 — Urdu Nazm (Theme: Temporality & The Passage of Time)
4. **ادھوری بات (Adhuri Baat)** — 2025 — Urdu Ghazal (Theme: Unspoken Words & Human Vulnerability)
5. **آنکھوں کی زبان (Aankhon Ki Zubaan)** — 2025 — Urdu Ghazal (Theme: Non-Verbal Emotional Expression)
6. **سپنوں کا شہر (Sapnon Ka Shehar)** — 2025 — Urdu Nazm (Theme: Ambition, Urban Life & Hope)
7. **خط (Khat)** — 2025 — Urdu Ghazal (Theme: Epistolary Reflection & Memory)
8. **الوداع (Alwida)** — 2026 — Urdu Nazm (Theme: Parting, Acceptance & Renewal)
